thread:
mina: Need a compact design sprint for the Apr webinar inbound funnel. Scope: one hero benchmark (1600x900), two-step SVG funnel, three social templates (IG/LI/X) with accessible color swaps, a mobile thumbnail (copy-first), and an email badge. Deadline: static comps tomorrow 10am PT.

ravi: Ok. For the hero: cost_per_1000 on x, p95_ms on y. No numeric claims '(legal)'. Show two non-quant annotations: "lower-cost" and "lower-latency".

celeste: Asset sizes: hero 1600x900, IG 1080x1080, LI 1200x627 (MP4 fallback), X 800x450, thumbnail 600x800. Badge round + pill, 3 sizes.

josh: Brand: neutral canvas (no purple gradient), type-scale v3, footer lockup must read "Redwood Inference  production-ready inference" and tiny source: "internal benchmark; illustrative". Alt text for all assets please. Contrast AA required.

mina: Animation: sparkline loop 10 frames, keep GIF <1.7MB for IG; MP4 <3MB for LI. Provide static fallbacks and SVG exports for funnels.

ravi: I'll import CSV now: https://drive.redwood/bench/apr-launch-2026.csv (fields: model,cost_per_1000,p95_ms,tokens_sec). Will drop cleaned metrics by 3pm PT; we'll bin p95>2200ms.

celeste: Naming convention: MIQ_launch2026_{asset}_{channel}_{variant}. Example: MIQ_launch2026_herobench_og_static. Tag Figma frames with release/launch-inbound/2026-04-14 for automated export.

brand-checker-bot: Reminder: legal flag if numeric claims or dollar savings appear. Automated checklist requires alt text, contrast, and export tags.

mina: Great. I'll post landing thumbnail copy in 30m. Please ping this thread when first comps are live so we can run a quick brand/legal sweep. Thanks! :sparkles:
